description: Source code for the xbb component, managing battery device status, configuration, alarms, and siren controls within a device management system.

methods.name: deviceAddedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles device added events, registers deviceId if device class is 'xbb'.

methods.name: deviceRemovedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles device removal events, clears deviceId if it matches the removed device.

methods.name: registerEventHandlers
methods.description: Registers event listeners for device added and removed events.

methods.name: unregisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Unregisters event listeners for device added and removed events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the module, sets up logging, and checks for paired battery.

methods.name: verifyBatteryPaired
methods.description: Checks if a battery device is currently paired.

methods.name: xbbIsBatteryPaired
methods.description: Requests list of devices of class 'xbb' and sets deviceId if found.

methods.name: batteryInCommFail
methods.description: Checks if the battery communication has failed.

methods.name: xbbGetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the battery device, including manufacturer, model, health, and JSON-parsed detailed status.

methods.name: xbbGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters of the battery device from endpoint resource.

methods.name: xbbSetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters on the battery device via endpoint resource.

methods.name: xbbDiscover
methods.description: Discovers or removes the battery device based on deviceId presence.

methods.name: xbbGetAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves alarm information from the device, parsing JSON array of alarms.

methods.name: xbbSirenStart
methods.description: Starts the siren with specified parameters by executing a resource request.

methods.name: xbbSirenStop
methods.description: Stops the siren by executing a resource request.

methods.name: xbbSirenMute
methods.description: Mutes the siren by executing a resource request.
